# #207 — Define agent memory adapter contract

State: CLOSED

## Goal
Define the first-class adapter contract that makes Open Brain usable as an agent memory substrate without agents hand-writing raw MCP lifecycle calls.

## Scope
- Define required adapter methods: start, recall, append_event, compact, wrap, record_receipt, nominate_shared, export_disclosure_bundle.
- Specify payload shapes for local Codex, Hermes, thin clients, and future Closed Brain.
- Document namespace, session_key, project, agent, channel/thread, and color/metadata expectations.
- Pin source-of-truth boundaries between server authority and client-side distillation.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Contract is documented in docs/agent-memory-substrate-plan.md or a linked contract doc.
- Server/client ownership is explicit.
- Contract names map to existing Open Brain tools or clearly marked new work.
- Downstream impact is classified under docs/downstream-rollout.md.

## Timeline
Target date: 2026-06-26. This is the planning gate for the Sunday 2026-06-28 memory substrate slice.

Parent plan: docs/agent-memory-substrate-plan.md
